name: Zhiwei Han
career: Independent wedding photographer specializing in UK countryside venues
bio: Zhiwei spends his days traveling between charming villages across the UK, capturing heartfelt moments for newlyweds. He enjoys experimenting with quirky angles and natural lighting, often bringing humor into his shoots to put couples at ease. At home, he spends quiet evenings studying English idioms and preparing sugar-free desserts, a hobby that began after a friendly baking contest with his church group. Though deeply committed to his clients, he also volunteers at a local wildlife rescue, photographing animals to help with adoption campaigns.
